title: HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2610.22195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. translated_title: HTN-Orchestrate：一种用于多智能体编排的分层任务网络框架
translated_abstract: 在复杂任务上编排多个智能体需要协调局部子任务执行与全局任务规划。动态调度方法提供了执行灵活性，但没有显式建模子任务的层次结构或依赖关系；而预定义工作流虽然强加了这种结构，却在执行开始前就固定了任务分解。因此，我们提出了 HTN-Orchestrate，这是一个双层框架，通过分层任务网络（HTN）将这两种职责分离。规划器（Planner）维护子任务的层次结构与依赖关系，将任务分解推迟到前置结果可用时才进行；而本地编排器则调度工作器执行每个叶子子任务。结果在 AND 语义下向上传播，当当前的任务分解无法解决任务时，累积的发现将为重建任务网络提供依据。在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流的五个基准测试上，HTN-Orch（原文在此处截断）
tldr: HTN-Orchestrate 提出了一种基于分层任务网络的双层多智能体编排框架，通过规划器将子任务分解延迟至前置结果可用时进行，由本地编排器调度执行，并在当前分解失败时依据累积发现重建任务网络，从而兼顾全局规划的层次结构与局部执行的灵活性。
en_tdlr: HTN-Orchestrate introduces a two-layer hierarchical task network framework for multi-agent orchestration that defers subtask decomposition until prerequisite results become available, schedules local workers for leaf subtasks, and rebuilds the task network when the current decomposition fails, balancing global planning structure with local execution flexibility.
